words.ex: He scraped his knee on the rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在粗糙的地面上擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: To remove something from a surface using a sharp or rough edge, or to injure a part of the body by rubbing it against a rough surface.

words.tr: adj. 无望的；凄凉的；荒凉的；
words.ex: The future looks bleak without a job.
words.ex_cn: 没有工作，未来看起来毫无希望。
words.en: If you describe a situation as bleak, you mean that it seems unlikely to improve or get better.

words.tr:
adj. 失职的；违法的；拖欠债务的
n. 违犯者；少年罪犯；违法者
words.ex: The delinquent worker ignored his duties.
words.ex_cn: 这位失职的员工忽视了他的职责。
words.en: A delinquent is someone, especially a young person, who commits a crime or breaks the law.

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.ex: Water can penetrate the soil slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水可以慢慢渗透进土壤。
words.en: To penetrate means to enter or pass through something, especially when this is difficult or when it is not obvious how to do it.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.ex: He lost his job because of his integrity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为正直而失去了工作。
words.en: Integrity is the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles.

words.ex: He gave an emotional speech about his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于他母亲的感人演讲。
words.en: Something that is emotional is connected with people's feelings. If someone is emotional, they show their feelings very openly, especially because they are upset.

words.tr:
v. 咕哝；（猪等）打呼噜
n. 咕哝；呼噜声
words.ex: He grunted when he lifted the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬起沉重的箱子时咕哝了一声。
words.en: To make a low, short guttural sound, typically to express dissatisfaction or effort.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.ex: The company streamlined its hiring process.
words.ex_cn: 公司简化了招聘流程。
words.en: To make something such as a business, organization, or process work more effectively by making it simpler or more efficient.

words.ex: The prospect of a better job makes him happy.
words.ex_cn: 更好工作的前景让他感到高兴。
words.en: A prospect is the possibility that something will happen, or a view of a wide area.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.tr:
v. 耗尽；用完；使筋疲力尽
n. 排气管；废气
words.ex: The long hike exhausted him.
words.ex_cn: 这次漫长的徒步旅行让他筋疲力尽。
words.en: If something exhausts you, it makes you so tired, either physically or mentally, that you have no energy left.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.ex: Two companies compete for the same customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为争夺相同的客户而竞争。
words.en: If you compete with someone for something, you try to get it for yourself and stop the other person getting it. You can also say that two people compete for something that they both want.

words.ex: He inserts a coin into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他把一枚硬币放进机器里。
words.en: To put or introduce something into something else.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.ex: His answer was apt for the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答对这个问题很恰当。
words.en: If someone is apt to do something, they often do it and so it is likely that they will do it again.

words.ex: From my standpoint, this plan is too risky.
words.ex_cn: 从我的立场来看，这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: A standpoint is a particular way of considering something, or a particular attitude towards it.

words.tr:
n. 残疾；障碍；阻碍；不利
v. 妨碍；使不利
words.ex: He has a physical handicap but still runs every day.
words.ex_cn: 他有身体残疾，但仍然每天跑步。
words.en: A handicap is a condition that markedly restricts a person's ability to function physically, mentally, or socially.

words.ex: His answers were inconsistent.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案不一致。
words.en: If you describe someone as inconsistent, you are criticizing them for not behaving in the same way every time a similar situation occurs.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: The price of oil soared last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月石油价格骤升。
words.en: To rise or increase dramatically in amount or level.

words.tr: adj. 某个；确定的；一定的；一定程度上的；
words.ex: I saw a certain man near the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园附近看到某个男人。
words.en: If you are certain about something, you have no doubt about it.

words.tr:
n. 草图；素描；概述
v. 草拟；速写；简述
words.ex: He made a quick sketch of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他快速画出了房子的草图。
words.en: A sketch is a simple, quickly-made drawing that does not have many details. It can also mean a short description or account of something.

words.ex: The tortuous road wound through the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条弯曲的道路蜿蜒穿过山脉。
words.en: If you describe something as tortuous, you mean that it is very long, complicated, and difficult to understand.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.ex: The slow internet frustrates me.
words.ex_cn: 慢速的网络让我感到沮丧。
words.en: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to deal with the problems it creates.

words.ex: The company announced a takeover of a smaller firm.
words.ex_cn: 公司宣布收购一家较小的企业。
words.en: The act of gaining control of a company by buying most of its shares.

words.ex: He gave an arrogant answer to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他傲慢地回答了老师的问题。
words.en: Someone who is arrogant behaves in a proud, unpleasant way towards other people because they believe that they are more important than others.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.tr:
adj. 首要的；大红色的
n. 红衣主教；枢机主教；基数
words.ex: This is a cardinal rule in our school.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们学校的一项首要规则。
words.en: A cardinal rule or quality is the most important one.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.tr:
n. 低语声；嘟哝
v. 低语；咕哝；私下抱怨
words.ex: I heard a murmur from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来低语声。
words.en: A murmur is a low, indistinct, continuous sound, as of a stream or of voices.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.tr: v. 使有尊严；使崇高；使显贵
words.ex: He tried to dignify his actions with excuses.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用借口来美化自己的行为。
words.en: To dignify something means to make it seem important and worthy of respect, often by treating it in a serious or formal way.

words.tr:
n. 询问；疑问；问号
v. 询问；怀疑
words.ex: He made a query about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了公交车的时刻表。
words.en: A query is a question, especially one that you ask in order to check that something is true or correct.

words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.ex: She showed great affection for her little dog.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的小狗非常钟爱。
words.en: A feeling of liking and caring for someone or something.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.ex: He adheres to his principles even when it's hard.
words.ex_cn: 即使很难，他仍然坚持自己的原则。
words.en: If you adhere to a rule or agreement, you act in the way that it says you should.

words.tr: n. 城河；壕坑; n. （Foss）人名；（德、英、法、西、瑞典）福斯
words.ex: The castle is surrounded by a deep foss.
words.ex_cn: 城堡被一条深城河环绕。
words.en: A fossilized remnant or trace of an organism from a past geological age.

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.tr: adj. 憔悴的；形容枯槁的
words.ex: He looked haggard after working all night.
words.ex_cn: 他熬了一整夜后看起来憔悴不堪。
words.en: Someone who is haggard looks exhausted and unwell, often because they have been through a very difficult or stressful experience.

words.ex: He capitalized on the chance to start a business.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了这个创业的机会。
words.en: To capitalize means to use something to your advantage, especially in a way that brings financial gain. It can also mean to write or print a word with its first letter as a capital letter.

words.tr: v. 考虑；“consider”的现在分词； prep. 考虑到；就…而言；鉴于；
words.ex: I am considering going to the park.
words.ex_cn: 我正在考虑去公园。
words.en: Taking into account; in view of.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: He retains his old photos in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧照片保存在一个盒子里。
words.en: If you retain something, you keep it or continue to have it.

words.ex: The gossip about the CEO made everyone shocked.
words.ex_cn: 关于CEO的流言蜚语让所有人都震惊了。
words.en: Gossip is informal conversation or reports about other people's private lives, which might be unkind or not true.

words.ex: They decided to prolong the meeting by one hour.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议延长一小时。
words.en: To prolong something means to make it last longer.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.tr: adj. 无效果的；不起作用的；不奏效的；
words.ex: The medicine was ineffective against the cold.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒无效。
words.en: If someone or something is ineffective, they do not achieve the intended result.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: The two countries signed a bilateral agreement.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项双边协议。
words.en: Involving or affecting two parties, countries, etc.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr:
v. 稀释
adj. 经稀释的
words.ex: He dilutes the juice with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水稀释果汁。
words.en: To dilute a liquid means to make it thinner or weaker by adding water or another liquid to it.

words.ex: He felt indignant when they blamed him for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 当他们把错误归咎于他时，他感到愤愤不平。
words.en: If you are indignant, you are shocked and angry, because you think that something is unjust or unfair.

words.tr: adj. 粗鲁的；生硬的；粗哑的
words.ex: The old man gave a gruff answer.
words.ex_cn: 老人粗声粗气地回答了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as gruff, you mean that they seem rather unfriendly or bad-tempered.

words.ex: The two roads diverge after the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在桥后分岔。
words.en: If one thing diverges from another similar thing, the first thing becomes different from the second or develops differently from it. You can also say that two things diverge.

words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.ex: The thick forest was impenetrable.
words.ex_cn: 这片茂密的森林无法穿越。
words.en: Impenetrable is used to describe something that cannot be passed through, entered, or understood.

words.tr: adj. 精美的；细腻的；强烈的
words.ex: She wore an exquisite dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精美的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is exquisite is extremely beautiful or pleasant, especially in a delicate or refined way.

words.ex: His upbringing taught him to be honest and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的抚育让他学会了诚实和善良。
words.en: The way that a child is cared for and taught how to behave while it is growing up.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: He gave an absolute yes to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议给出了完全肯定的回答。
words.en: Absolute means complete and total, or not limited in any way.

words.tr:
n. 接触；联系；
v. 接触；联系；
words.ex: The two balls made contact when they collided.
words.ex_cn: 两个球在碰撞时发生了接触。
words.en: Contact refers to the act of communicating with someone, especially regularly, or the state of touching something.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.tr: adj. 怀疑的；令人怀疑的；
words.ex: The police felt suspicious about the man's behavior.
words.ex_cn: 警察对这个人的行为感到怀疑。
words.en: If you are suspicious of someone or something, you do not trust them, and are careful when dealing with them.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.tr:
n. 狂乱；狂暴；狂怒
v. 使狂乱；使狂怒
words.ex: The crowd went into a frenzy when the singer appeared.
words.ex_cn: 当歌手出现时，人群陷入了狂热。
words.en: A frenzy is a state of uncontrolled excitement or wild behavior.

words.ex: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律强迫司机系安全带。
words.en: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

words.ex: The loud noise frightened the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音吓到了孩子。
words.en: If something or someone frightens you, they cause you to suddenly feel afraid, anxious, or nervous.

words.ex: It is unreasonable to expect help without asking.
words.ex_cn: 不请求帮助就指望别人帮忙是不合理的。
words.en: If you say that someone is being unreasonable, you mean that they are behaving in a way that is not fair or sensible.

words.ex: Birds fly south by instinct.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类凭本能飞向南方。
words.en: An instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 流浪汉；流浪乞丐；徒步旅行
v. 步行；踩；踏
words.ex: The old tramp slept on the park bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个老流浪汉睡在公园的长椅上。
words.en: If you tramp somewhere, you walk there slowly and with regular, heavy steps, especially for a long time.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.ex: The old abbey stands on a hill near the village.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的修道院坐落在村庄附近的山上。
words.en: A complex of buildings housing a monastery or convent, typically including a church, living quarters, and other facilities.

words.ex: He touched his abdomen after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后摸了摸肚子。
words.en: The abdomen is the part of the body between the chest and the pelvis, containing the stomach, intestines, liver, and other organs.

words.ex: The boy has an abnormal heartbeat.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩的心跳不正常。
words.en: Deviating from what is normal or usual, typically in a way that is undesirable or worrying.

words.tr: n. 土著；（尤指澳大利亚的）土著居民
words.ex: The aborigine lived in the desert for thousands of years.
words.ex_cn: 这位土著在沙漠中生活了数千年。
words.en: An aborigine is one of the original or earliest known inhabitants of a country or region.

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.ex: He is an ace at playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是打篮球的好手。
words.en: If you describe someone such as a sports player as an ace, you mean that they are very good at what they do.

words.tr:
n. 疼痛；隐痛；渴望
v. 疼痛；隐痛
words.ex: My head aches after staying up late.
words.ex_cn: 我熬夜后头痛。
words.en: If you ache or a part of your body aches, you feel a steady, fairly strong pain.

words.ex: He owns five acres of farmland.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有五英亩的农田。
words.en: A unit of area used in the US Customary and the British Imperial systems, equal to 4,840 square yards or 4,046.86 square meters.

words.tr: n. 杂技演员；立场观点善变的人
words.ex: The acrobat jumps high on the tightrope.
words.ex_cn: 杂技演员在钢丝上跳得很高。
words.en: An acrobat is someone who entertains people by performing difficult physical acts such as jumping and balancing, especially in a circus.

words.ex: NASA is an acronym for National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
words.ex_cn: NASA 是美国国家航空航天局的缩写。
words.en: An acronym is a word formed from the initial letters of the words in a phrase, especially when this is used as a name.

words.ex: He tried acupuncture to relieve his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他尝试针刺疗法来缓解背痛。
words.en: Acupuncture is a form of treatment that involves inserting very thin needles through a person's skin at specific points on the body, to various depths, for therapeutic purposes.

words.ex: The admiral gave orders to the navy.
words.ex_cn: 海军上将向海军下达了命令。
words.en: An admiral is a senior officer in the navy, in particular the commander of a fleet or a high-ranking officer.

words.ex: The birds flew through the aerial sky.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在空中飞翔。
words.en: An aerial is a wire or rod that sends or receives radio or television signals. As an adjective, aerial describes things that are in the air or related to the air.

words.ex: He loves studying aeronautics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在大学里学习航空学。
words.en: The science or practice of travel through the air.

words.ex: The aeroplane flies high in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在高空中飞行。
words.en: An aeroplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.ex: She loves the aesthetics of old buildings.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢老建筑的美感。
words.en: Aesthetics is a branch of philosophy dealing with the nature of beauty, art, and taste, and with the creation and appreciation of beauty.

words.tr: n. 后果；余波；事后影响
words.ex: The medicine had an aftereffect that made him sleepy.
words.ex_cn: 这种药有一个副作用，让他感到困倦。
words.en: An aftereffect is a delayed effect or consequence of an event or action.

words.ex: We ate dinner, and afterward we watched a movie.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，之后看了部电影。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterward, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.ex: We had dinner, and afterwards we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，后来去散步了。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterwards, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.ex: The air is clean after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气很清新。
words.en: Air is the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

words.tr: n. 空军基地；航空基地
words.ex: The soldiers live near the airbase.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们住在空军基地附近。
words.en: An airbase is a military airport where military aircraft take off and land, and where they are maintained and stored.

words.tr:
adj. 备有空调装置的
v. 给…装上空调器；“air-condition”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The bus is air-conditioned.
words.ex_cn: 这辆公交车有空调。
words.en: Equipped with an air-conditioning system to control the temperature and humidity of the air.

words.ex: The aircraft landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这架航空器在机场安全着陆。
words.en: An aircraft is a vehicle which can fly, for example an aeroplane or a helicopter.

words.ex: The plane landed on the airfield.
words.ex_cn: 飞机降落在机场。
words.en: An airfield is a place where aircraft can take off and land, usually having a runway but not necessarily the buildings and facilities of a full airport.

words.tr: phrase. 空中小姐；女性客舱乘务员
words.ex: The air hostess served drinks to passengers.
words.ex_cn: 空乘人员为乘客提供饮料。
words.en: A woman whose job is to serve and take care of passengers on an aircraft.

words.ex: The airliner landed safely at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这架客机安全地降落在机场。
words.en: A large commercial airplane designed to carry passengers on scheduled flights.

words.tr: n. 航空邮件；航空邮政
words.ex: He sent the letter by airmail.
words.ex_cn: 他通过航空邮件寄出了这封信。
words.en: Airmail is the system of sending letters, parcels, and other items by air, which is faster than sending them by land or sea.

words.ex: The jar is airtight, so the food stays fresh.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是密封的，所以食物能保持新鲜。
words.en: If something is airtight, it is completely sealed so that no air can get in or out.

words.ex: The infection blocked his airway.
words.ex_cn: 感染堵塞了他的呼吸道。
words.en: An airway is a passage for air to flow, especially in the respiratory system, or a designated route for aircraft.

words.ex: The books are on the shelf beside the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 书在过道旁边的架子上。
words.en: An aisle is a long narrow gap that people can walk along between rows of seats in a public building such as a church or between rows of shelves in a supermarket.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.tr: n. 含酒精的饮料；酒精；
words.ex: He drank alcohol at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上喝了含酒精的饮料。
words.en: Alcohol is a colourless liquid that can make you drunk, and which is used in medicines, cleaning products, and other substances.

words.ex: He drank a glass of ale at the pub.
words.ex_cn: 他在酒吧喝了一杯麦芽酒。
words.en: Ale is a type of beer that is brewed using a warm fermentation method, resulting in a sweet, full-bodied and fruity taste.

words.ex: The pond is full of green algae.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里长满了绿色藻类。
words.en: Algae are simple plants that can range from the microscopic (microalgae), to large seaweeds (macroalgae), such as giant kelp more than one hundred feet in length.

words.ex: He solves algebra problems every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天解代数题。
words.en: Algebra is a branch of mathematics in which letters and symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.ex: The alligator swims slowly in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鳄鱼在河里慢慢游动。
words.en: An alligator is a large reptile with a long body, thick skin, and a long tail, living in the water and on land in the hot wet parts of America and China.

words.tr:
n. 合金
v. 把…铸成合金
words.ex: He made a strong alloy from copper and zinc.
words.ex_cn: 他用铜和锌制造了一种坚固的合金。
words.en: An alloy is a metal made by combining two or more metallic elements, especially to give greater strength or resistance to corrosion.

words.ex: France was an ally of the United States in the war.
words.ex_cn: 法国在战争中是美国的同盟者。
words.en: An ally is a country, organization, or person that helps and supports another country, organization, or person in a difficult situation.

words.ex: God is almighty and can do anything.
words.ex_cn: 上帝是全能的，能做任何事。
words.en: The Almighty is used to refer to God. It can also describe something that has very great power or influence.

words.ex: The almond grows in warm climates.
words.ex_cn: 杏树生长在温暖的气候中。
words.en: An almond is the seed of the almond tree, which is often eaten as a nut.

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.ex: The priest placed the offering on the altar.
words.ex_cn: 牧师把供品放在祭坛上。
words.en: An altar is a raised area in a place of worship where people can honor God with offerings.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: The can is made of aluminium.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是铝制的。
words.en: A chemical element that is a light, silver-coloured metal, used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: She is an alumna of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 她是哈佛大学的校友。
words.en: An alumna is a female former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.ex: He is an alumnus of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的男毕业生。
words.en: An alumnus is a former student of a particular school, college, or university.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: He is an ambassador to France.
words.ex_cn: 他是驻法国的大使。
words.en: An ambassador is an official envoy, especially a high-ranking diplomat who represents a state and is usually accredited to another sovereign state or to an international organization as the resident representative of their own government or sovereign or appointed for a special and often temporary diplomatic assignment.

words.ex: She wore a necklace made of amber.
words.ex_cn: 她戴了一条琥珀制成的项链。
words.en: Amber is a hard, translucent, yellowish-brown substance that is used for making jewelry or other objects. It is formed from the resin of ancient trees.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.tr: n. 安培计；电表；电流表
words.ex: The electrician used an ammeter to measure the current in the circuit.
words.ex_cn: 电工使用安培计来测量电路中的电流。
words.en: An ammeter is a device that measures the electric current in a circuit.

words.ex: Ammonia has a strong smell.
words.ex_cn: 氨有一种刺鼻的气味。
words.en: Ammonia is a colorless gas with a characteristic pungent smell. It is used in the manufacture of fertilizers and as a refrigerant.

words.ex: The soldiers loaded ammunition into their guns.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们把弹药装进枪里。
words.en: Ammunition refers to the projectiles and propelling charges used in guns, firearms, or any other weapons.

words.ex: The wire carries one ampere of current.
words.ex_cn: 这根导线承载一安培的电流。
words.en: The ampere is the base unit of electric current in the International System of Units (SI).

words.ex: The students learned the anatomy of the human heart.
words.ex_cn: 学生们学习了人类心脏的解剖组织构造。
words.en: Anatomy is the study of the structure of the bodies of people or animals.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船在港口放下了锚。
words.en: An anchor is a heavy object that is dropped from a boat or a ship into the water to prevent the vessel from moving.

words.ex: The anchorman reported the news every evening.
words.ex_cn: 主播每天晚上播报新闻。
words.en: An anchorman is a man who presents a news programme on television or radio.

words.tr: n. 广播新闻的女主持人；女主播
words.ex: She is an anchorwoman on the evening news.
words.ex_cn: 她是晚间新闻的女主播。
words.en: A woman who presents a news broadcast on television or radio.

words.ex: He told an anecdote about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的趣事。
words.en: An anecdote is a short, amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.

words.ex: The child drew a picture of an angel with wings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅有翅膀的天使的画。
words.en: An angel is a spiritual being believed to act as a messenger or servant of God, conventionally represented in human form with wings and a long robe.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: He twisted his ankle while running.
words.ex_cn: 他在跑步时扭伤了脚踝。
words.en: The joint between the foot and the leg, in which movement occurs in two planes.

words.tr: n. 年鉴；编年史；历史记载；年报
words.ex: The annals of history record many great kings.
words.ex_cn: 历史年鉴记录了许多伟大的国王。
words.en: A chronological record of events, especially those of a particular organization, institution, or community.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.tr: n. （电解池的）阳极；（原电池的）负极
words.ex: The current flows into the anode during electrolysis.
words.ex_cn: 在电解过程中，电流流入阳极。
words.en: An anode is the positively charged electrode by which the electrons leave a device.

words.tr:
v. 回答；回应；
n. 回答；答案；
words.ex: He answered the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: An answer is something that you say or write when you reply to a question or remark.

words.tr: n. 对抗；对立；敌对状态（行为）
words.ex: There is antagonism between the two neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 这两个邻居之间有敌意。
words.en: Antagonism is a strong feeling of dislike or opposition towards someone or something.

words.tr: n. 对手；对立者；对抗者
words.ex: The antagonist in the story is a greedy king.
words.ex_cn: 故事中的反派是一个贪婪的国王。
words.en: An antagonist is someone who opposes another person.

words.tr:
adj. 南极的；
n. 南极地区；
words.ex: The antarctic ice is melting fast.
words.ex_cn: 南极的冰正在迅速融化。
words.en: The Antarctic is the area around the South Pole, characterized by its cold climate and ice-covered landscapes.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.tr: n. 国家或组织的法定歌曲
words.ex: The team sang the national anthem before the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛前，球队唱了国歌。
words.en: An anthem is a song that is used to represent a particular nation, society, or group and that is sung on special occasions.

words.ex: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my infection.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了抗菌素治疗感染。
words.en: A substance that can kill or inhibit the growth of bacteria and other microorganisms.

words.ex: His antic behavior made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他滑稽的行为让大家都笑了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as antic, you mean that it is strange and foolish in a way that is amusing.

words.ex: The doctor used antiseptic cream on the cut.
words.ex_cn: 医生在伤口上用了防腐药膏。
words.en: An antiseptic is a substance that prevents the growth of disease-causing microorganisms.

words.ex: The antonym of 'hot' is 'cold'.
words.ex_cn: ‘hot’的反义词是‘cold’。
words.en: An antonym is a word that means the opposite of another word.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.ex: The ape climbed slowly up the tree.
words.ex_cn: 这只猿慢慢爬上了树。
words.en: An ape is a large primate that does not have a tail, for example a chimpanzee or gorilla.

words.ex: The photographer adjusted the aperture to make the photo brighter.
words.ex_cn: 摄影师调整了光圈，使照片更亮。
words.en: An aperture is a hole or an opening through which light passes, particularly in the context of cameras or optical instruments.

words.ex: The word 'it's' has an apostrophe.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'it's' 中有一个撇号。
words.en: An apostrophe is a punctuation mark used to indicate either possession or the omission of letters or numbers.

words.ex: The lab has a new apparatus for measuring temperature.
words.ex_cn: 实验室有一台新的温度测量装置。
words.en: The complex structure of a particular system or organization, or the equipment used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He has an appetite for spicy food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢辛辣食物。
words.en: A desire or liking for something, especially food.

words.ex: The kitchen has a new washing appliance.
words.ex_cn: 厨房里有一台新的洗衣机。
words.en: An appliance is a device or machine that is used to perform a particular task, especially in the home.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.tr:
n. 杏；杏树；杏黄色
adj. 杏黄色的
words.ex: He ate a sweet apricot for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个甜杏子当点心。
words.en: An apricot is a small, soft, round fruit with yellowish-orange flesh and a stone inside.

words.ex: She wears a white apron while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她做饭时穿着一件白色围裙。
words.en: An apron is a piece of clothing that you wear over the front of your normal clothes and tie round your waist, especially when you are cooking, in order to prevent your clothes from getting dirty.

words.ex: He has a natural aptitude for math.
words.ex_cn: 他天生有数学天赋。
words.en: An aptitude is a natural ability to do something.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.tr: adj. 水生的；水栖的；水中的；
words.ex: The fish live in aquatic plants.
words.ex_cn: 这些鱼生活在水生植物中。
words.en: Relating to water; living in or near water or taking place in water.

words.tr:
v. 成弧线；
n. 弧；弧形物；
words.ex: The rainbow arcs across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹在天空中形成一道弧线。
words.en: An arc is a smoothly curving line or movement.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.ex: The archaeologist found an old pot in the ground.
words.ex_cn: 这位考古学家在地下发现了一个旧陶罐。
words.en: An archaeologist is someone who studies the societies and cultures of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: He loves archaeology and digs old artifacts.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱考古学，挖掘古代文物。
words.en: Archaeology is the study of the societies and peoples of the past by examining the remains of their buildings, tools, and other objects.

words.ex: The archbishop gave a speech at the church.
words.ex_cn: 大主教在教堂发表了一次演讲。
words.en: An archbishop is a bishop of the highest rank who is in charge of an archdiocese.

words.ex: The old archway stands at the entrance of the town.
words.ex_cn: 古老的拱门矗立在小镇的入口处。
words.en: An archway is a passage or entrance that has a curved roof, often found in the entrance to a building or in a wall.

words.tr:
n. 北极地区；
adj. 北极的；
words.ex: Polar bears live in the arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极地区。
words.en: The Arctic is the area around the Earth's North Pole, characterized by cold temperatures and ice.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.tr: n. 贵族政治；贵族统治；贵族
words.ex: The aristocracy lived in big castles long ago.
words.ex_cn: 很久以前，贵族住在巨大的城堡里。
words.en: The highest class in certain societies, especially those holding hereditary titles or offices.

words.ex: The aristocrat lived in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 这位贵族住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: An aristocrat is a person of high rank in a society, especially one who inherits a title and lands.

words.ex: He does arithmetic every day with his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和妹妹一起做算术。
words.en: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that deals with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

words.ex: The country increased its armament to protect its borders.
words.ex_cn: 该国增加了军备以保护其边境。
words.en: The weapons and military equipment that a country has, or the process of increasing them.

words.ex: He sits in the armchair and reads the newspaper.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在扶手椅上读报纸。
words.en: An armchair is a comfortable chair with sides that support your arms.

words.ex: The knight wore heavy armour in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 骑士在战斗中穿着沉重的盔甲。
words.en: Armour is a protective covering that is used to prevent damage from being inflicted to an object, individual, or vehicle by direct contact weapons or projectiles, usually during combat.

words.ex: He put deodorant on his armpit.
words.ex_cn: 他在腋窝上涂了止汗剂。
words.en: The hollow under the arm at the shoulder.

words.ex: The hunter shot an arrow at the target.
words.ex_cn: 猎人向目标射了一支箭。
words.en: An arrow is a long thin weapon which is sharp and pointed at one end and which often has feathers at the other end. Arrows are shot from a bow.

words.ex: The artery carries blood from the heart.
words.ex_cn: 动脉将血液从心脏输送到身体。
words.en: An artery is a tube that carries blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: The army used artillery to attack the enemy base.
words.ex_cn: 军队用火炮攻击了敌方基地。
words.en: Artillery refers to large-caliber guns used in warfare on land.

words.ex: He felt ashamed for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对妈妈撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: If someone is ashamed, they feel embarrassed or guilty because of something they have done or because of their appearance.

words.ex: He put the cigarette in the ashtray.
words.ex_cn: 他把香烟放进烟灰缸里。
words.en: An ashtray is a small dish in which smokers can put the ash from their cigarettes or cigars.

words.tr:
n. 沥青；柏油
v. 用沥青铺
words.ex: The workers laid new asphalt on the road.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在道路上铺了新的沥青。
words.en: Asphalt is a black, sticky substance used especially for making the surface of roads.

words.tr: n. 阿司匹林（镇痛解热消炎药）
words.ex: He took aspirin for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了阿司匹林来缓解头痛。
words.en: Aspirin is a common drug that is used to reduce pain and inflammation.

words.ex: The farmer rides his ass to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫骑着他的驴去市场。
words.en: An ass is a donkey, a domesticated animal of the horse family, or a foolish or stupid person.

words.ex: The king was killed by an assassin.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一名刺客杀害了。
words.en: An assassin is a person who murders an important person for political or religious reasons.

words.ex: The king was assassinated by a secret group.
words.ex_cn: 国王被一个秘密组织刺杀。
words.en: To assassinate someone means to murder them, especially for political reasons or for payment.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.ex: He loves watching stars and learning astronomy.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢看星星并学习天文学。
words.en: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

words.tr: adj. 运动的；身强力壮的；
words.ex: He is an athletic boy who loves running.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱跑步的运动型男孩。
words.en: Athletic is used to describe someone who is physically strong, fit, and good at sports, or something related to sports or physical activities.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The atom is the smallest part of matter.
words.ex_cn: 原子是物质的最小单位。
words.en: An atom is the smallest unit of ordinary matter that forms a chemical element. Every solid, liquid, gas, and plasma is composed of neutral or ionized atoms.

words.tr: n. 专员；公使；使馆随员；大使馆专员
words.ex: He worked as a military attaché at the embassy.
words.ex_cn: 他在大使馆担任武官。
words.en: An attaché is a person who is attached to a diplomatic mission in a specific capacity, often as a specialist in a particular field.

words.ex: The children found old toys in the attic.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阁楼上找到了旧玩具。
words.en: An attic is a space or room just below the roof of a building, often used for storage or as an extra room.

words.tr: n. 律师；辩护律师；代理人
words.ex: The attorney helped the man with his case.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助那个人处理了他的案件。
words.en: An attorney is a lawyer who is qualified to represent a client in court.

words.ex: The teacher used audiovisuals to teach the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用视听教具来授课。
words.en: Materials or equipment that involve both hearing and seeing, used especially in teaching or presentations.

words.ex: The company hired an expert to do an audit.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一位专家进行审计。
words.en: An audit is an official examination of the accounts of a business or organization to check that they are accurate and correct.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: He passed the aural test by listening carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他通过仔细听通过了听力测试。
words.en: Relating to the ear or the sense of hearing.

words.ex: He wrote his autobiography when he was 70.
words.ex_cn: 他70岁时写了自传。
words.en: An autobiography is a book about the life of a person, written by that person.

words.ex: The factory will automate the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 工厂将自动化装配线。
words.en: To automate a factory, office, or industrial process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.tr: n. 自主权；自治权；自治；
words.ex: The region demands autonomy from the central government.
words.ex_cn: 该地区要求从中央政府获得自主权。
words.en: Autonomy is the ability or condition of being self-governing; independence in one's thoughts or actions.

words.ex: Applications arrived in an avalanche after the job posting.
words.ex_cn: 职位发布后，申请纷至沓来。
words.en: An avalanche is a large mass of snow, ice, and rocks that falls quickly down the side of a mountain.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: He picked up an axe to chop wood.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把斧子去砍柴。
words.en: An axe is a tool used for chopping wood, typically consisting of a heavy metal blade fixed at a right angle at the end of a long handle. As a verb, to axe means to dismiss or reduce something drastically.

words.ex: An axiom is a fact that everyone accepts.
words.ex_cn: 公理是一个大家普遍接受的事实。
words.en: An axiom is a statement or proposition which is regarded as being established, accepted, or self-evidently true.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.ex: The wheel fell off because the axle broke.
words.ex_cn: 车轮掉了，因为车轴断了。
words.en: An axle is a rod or spindle (either fixed or rotating) passing through the center of a wheel or group of wheels.

words.ex: He is the backbone of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是团队的中坚。
words.en: The backbone is the most important part of something, providing support and strength.

words.ex: The team has a strong backup for the captain.
words.ex_cn: 这支队伍有一位强大的后援来代替队长。
words.en: A backup is a copy of a file or other item of data made in case the original is lost or damaged. It can also refer to support or assistance provided to someone or something.

words.ex: He ate eggs and bacon for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了鸡蛋和培根。
words.en: Bacon is a type of salt-cured pork made from various cuts, typically from the pork belly or from back cuts, which are less fatty than the belly.

words.ex: Bacteria can make you sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌会让你生病。
words.en: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause diseases.

words.ex: He wears a badge on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他衬衫上戴着一枚徽章。
words.en: A badge is a small piece of metal, plastic, or cloth which you wear in order to show people that you have a particular rank, job, or belong to a particular group.

words.tr: n. 羽毛球运动；羽毛球；
words.ex: He plays badminton every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打羽毛球。
words.en: A game played with rackets and a shuttlecock, which is hit back and forth across a high net.

words.tr: adj. 脾气不好的；易怒的
words.ex: He is bad-tempered when he wakes up late.
words.ex_cn: 他起床晚的时候脾气很坏。
words.en: If you describe someone as bad-tempered, you mean that they become angry or annoyed easily.

words.tr:
n. 鱼饵；诱惑物
v. 下诱饵
words.ex: He used bread as bait to catch fish.
words.ex_cn: 他用面包当诱饵来钓鱼。
words.en: Bait is something which is used to attract fish or animals so that they can be caught. It can also refer to something that is offered to someone to persuade them to do something.

words.ex: She bakes bread every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日都烤面包。
words.en: To bake is to cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 包；捆
v. 捆成大包
words.ex: He tied the hay into a bale.
words.ex_cn: 他把干草捆成一捆。
words.en: A bale is a large quantity of something such as hay, paper, wool, or cloth that has been tied tightly into a rectangular shape.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr:
v. 进行无记名投票 
n. 无记名投票
words.ex: He cast his ballot in the election.
words.ex_cn: 他在选举中投了票。
words.en: A ballot is a process of voting, in writing and typically in secret. It is also the piece of paper on which you mark your vote.

words.ex: The band is playing music.
words.ex_cn: 这个乐队在演奏音乐。
words.en: A band is a group of musicians who play music together, especially popular music. It can also refer to a strip of material used for binding or decoration, or a range of frequencies or wavelengths in a spectrum.

words.ex: The bandit stole money from the bank.
words.ex_cn: 强盗从银行偷了钱。
words.en: A bandit is a person who robs people, especially one of a group of people who attack travelers.

words.ex: The bang woke me up at midnight.
words.ex_cn: 那声巨响在午夜把我吵醒了。
words.en: A bang is a sudden loud noise such as the noise of an explosion.

words.tr: n. 栏杆的支柱；楼梯的扶栏
words.ex: He held the banister while walking up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼梯时扶着栏杆的支柱。
words.en: A banister is the handrail on the side of a staircase, which people can hold onto for support.

words.tr: n. 银行业；银行业务； v. “bank”的现在分词；
words.ex: He works in banking in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事银行业。
words.en: Banking refers to the business activity of accepting and safeguarding money owned by other individuals and entities, and then lending out this money in order to earn a profit.

words.ex: He waved a red banner in the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面红旗子。
words.en: A banner is a long strip of cloth with a message or design on it, used especially for advertising or as a symbol of a particular group or cause.

words.ex: They had a big banquet after the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼后他们举办了一场盛大的宴会。
words.en: A banquet is a large formal meal for many people, often followed by speeches in honor of someone.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: We had a barbecue in the park last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们在公园举行了户外烧烤。
words.en: A barbecue is a meal or gathering at which meat, fish, or other food is cooked out of doors on a rack over an open fire or on a special appliance.

words.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.
words.ex_cn: 理发师每天剪头发。
words.en: A barber is a person whose job is cutting men's hair and sometimes shaving their beards.

words.ex: The barge carried coal down the river.
words.ex_cn: 驳船沿河运送煤炭。
words.en: A barge is a long, flat-bottomed boat used for carrying freight on canals and rivers.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: Farmers grow barley for animal feed.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植大麦作为动物饲料。
words.en: Barley is a cereal grain that is used as food and also in making beer and whiskey.

words.ex: The farmer stores hay in the barn.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把干草存放在谷仓里。
words.en: A barn is a large building on a farm in which crops or animals are kept.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.ex: The baron owns a large castle in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 男爵拥有一座位于乡村的大城堡。
words.en: A baron is a man who is a member of the lowest rank of the nobility, or a powerful businessman with great influence in a particular industry.

words.tr: n. 营房；兵营；（一片）简陋的大房子
words.ex: The soldiers live in the barracks near the base.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们住在基地附近的兵营里。
words.en: A barracks is a building or group of buildings where soldiers live.

words.ex: He poured water into a wooden barrel.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进一个木桶里。
words.en: A barrel is a large, round container for liquids or food, typically made of wood or metal.

words.ex: The toys are in the basement.
words.ex_cn: 玩具在地下室里。
words.en: The basement of a building is a room or area that is partly or completely below ground level.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.ex: He caught a big bass in the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他在湖里钓到了一条大鲈鱼。
words.en: The lowest adult male singing voice; or the musical part that is the lowest in pitch.

words.tr:
n. 私生子；浑蛋
adj. 私生的
words.ex: He called his brother a bastard during the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵时称他哥哥是杂种。
words.en: A bastard is a child whose parents were not married to each other at the time of its birth. This term can also be used as an insult to describe someone who is considered to be despicable or unpleasant.

words.ex: The bakery made a new batch of bread this morning.
words.ex_cn: 这家面包店今天早上做了一批新面包。
words.en: A batch is a quantity or consignment of goods produced at one time.

words.tr:
v. 沐浴；用水洗；沉浸
n. 游泳
words.ex: He bathes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上洗澡。
words.en: To bathe means to wash oneself or someone else, especially in a bath or the sea, or to spend time in water for pleasure.

words.ex: The remote needs a new battery.
words.ex_cn: 遥控器需要新电池。
words.en: A battery is a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, toys, etc.

words.ex: The beacon shines at night to guide ships.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔在夜晚发光以引导船只。
words.en: A beacon is a light or a fire, usually on a hill or tower, which acts as a signal or a warning.

words.ex: She threaded a bead onto the string.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗有孔的小珠穿在绳子上。
words.en: A bead is a small piece of glass, wood, or plastic that is used for decorating clothes or making jewellery.

words.ex: The bird uses its beak to eat seeds.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟用它的喙吃种子。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part of a bird's mouth, used for picking up and eating food.

words.ex: He pours water into the beaker.
words.ex_cn: 他把水倒进烧杯里。
words.en: A beaker is a glass or plastic container used in laboratories. It is cylindrical in shape, with a flat bottom and a small spout for pouring.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: He eats bean-sprout in his salad.
words.ex_cn: 他在沙拉里吃豆芽。
words.en: A bean-sprout is a sprout from a bean, typically used as a vegetable in cooking.

words.ex: He grew a thick beard last winter.
words.ex_cn: 去年冬天他留了一脸浓密的胡须。
words.en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

words.ex: The beast ran fast through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 那只野兽在森林里快速奔跑。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.ex: He picked a red berry from the bush.
words.ex_cn: 他从灌木丛中摘了一颗红色浆果。
words.en: A berry is a small, round fruit that grows on a bush or a tree. Some berries are edible and can be eaten raw or used in cooking.

words.tr:
n. 泊位；（船上的）卧铺
v. 停泊；占铺位
words.ex: The ship found a berth at the dock.
words.ex_cn: 船在码头找到了停泊位。
words.en: A berth is a bed on a boat, train, or other vehicle, or a place where a boat or ship can be tied up in a harbor.

words.ex: This book is a best-seller in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在许多国家都是畅销书。
words.en: A best-seller is a book or other product that sells in very large numbers.

words.tr:
v. 敢说；
n. 打赌；赌注；
words.ex: I bet you didn't know that.
words.ex_cn: 我敢说你不知道那件事。
words.en: If you bet on the result of a horse race, football game, or other event, you give someone a sum of money which they give you back with extra money if the result is what you predicted, or which they keep if it is not.

words.ex: He drinks a cold beverage after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝一杯冷饮。
words.en: A drink, especially one other than water; a liquid for drinking.

words.ex: He added the bibliography at the end of his report.
words.ex_cn: 他在报告末尾添加了参考书目。
words.en: A bibliography is a list of the books and articles that have been used by someone when writing a particular book or article.

words.tr: adj. 两种语言的；用两种语言的；
words.ex: He is a bilingual student who speaks English and Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个会说英语和西班牙语的双语学生。
words.en: A bilingual person is someone who can speak two languages equally well.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: The computer uses binary code to process data.
words.ex_cn: 计算机使用二进制代码来处理数据。
words.en: Relating to, composed of, or involving two things.

words.ex: He uses binoculars to watch birds in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他用望远镜在公园里看鸟。
words.en: Binoculars are an instrument that you hold up to your eyes to look at objects that are far away. It consists of two small telescopes joined together.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: He likes biology because it teaches about animals and plants.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢生物学，因为它教关于动物和植物的知识。
words.en: Biology is the science which is concerned with the study of living things.

words.ex: He works in a lab that uses biotechnology.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个使用生物技术的实验室工作。
words.en: Biotechnology is the use of living cells and bacteria in industrial and scientific processes.

words.ex: The birch trees have white bark.
words.ex_cn: 桦树有白色的树皮。
words.en: A birch is a type of tree with thin branches and a smooth trunk, which is often white or silver in color.

words.ex: The bishop moves diagonally across the chessboard.
words.ex_cn: 象在国际象棋棋盘上斜着走。
words.en: A bishop is a senior member of the Christian clergy, usually in charge of a diocese and empowered to confer holy orders.

words.ex: He feels pain in his bladder.
words.ex_cn: 他感到膀胱疼痛。
words.en: A bladder is a part of your body that is shaped like a bag and holds urine until it is passed out of the body.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.tr:
v. 咩咩叫；哀怨、微弱地抱怨
n. 咩咩叫声；哀怨、微弱的抱怨
words.ex: The sheep bleat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 羊在田野里咩咩叫。
words.en: If a sheep or goat bleats, it makes the typical sound of these animals.

words.ex: He got a blister on his foot from new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他新鞋磨出了一个水泡。
words.en: A blister is a small pocket of fluid within the upper layers of the skin, typically caused by forceful rubbing, burning, freezing, chemical exposure or infection. As a verb, it means to form such a pocket of fluid.

words.ex: The blond man smiled at the children.
words.ex_cn: 那个白肤金发的男子对孩子们微笑了。
words.en: If someone has blond hair, it is pale yellow in color.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.ex: He lost a lot of blood after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失了很多血。
words.en: The red liquid that flows through the bodies of humans and animals, carrying oxygen and nutrients.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空是蓝色的。
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.ex: The architect showed us the blueprint of the new house.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师给我们看了新房子的蓝图。
words.en: A blueprint is a detailed plan or design of something, often used in the context of buildings or machinery, which shows how it is to be made or how it will work.

words.ex: The celebrity has a bodyguard to keep him safe.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人有一个保镖来保护他的安全。
words.en: A bodyguard is a person or group of people employed to protect someone.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.tr: adj. 如骨的；多骨的；瘦骨嶙峋的
words.ex: He has a bony hand that looks thin and weak.
words.ex_cn: 他有一只骨瘦如柴的手，看起来又细又弱。
words.en: If you describe someone as bony, you mean that they are very thin so that their bones stick out.

words.tr: adj. 书本上的；好读书的；书呆子气的
words.ex: He is too bookish and doesn't know real life.
words.ex_cn: 他太书本气了，不懂现实生活。
words.en: Someone who is bookish spends a lot of time reading serious books and is more interested in ideas than in people or activities.

words.ex: He does bookkeeping for his small shop.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的小商店做记账。
words.en: Bookkeeping is the job or activity of keeping an accurate record of the money that is spent and received by a business or other organization.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: The river marks the borderline between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河标志着两个国家的边界线。
words.en: If you describe something as borderline, you mean that it is only just acceptable as a member of a class or group, or that it is only just good enough to be considered as such.

words.ex: He lives in a quiet borough of New York.
words.ex_cn: 他住在纽约的一个安静的行政区。
words.en: A borough is a town, or a district within a large city, that has its own local government.

words.tr:
n. 胸；怀；（女性的）乳房
adj. 亲密的；知心的
words.ex: She held the baby close to her bosom.
words.ex_cn: 她把婴儿紧紧抱在胸前。
words.en: Your bosom is the front part of your chest, especially the part that is covered by your clothes and where your breasts are.

words.ex: He loves studying botany in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在花园里学习植物学。
words.en: Botany is the scientific study of plants.

words.ex: The slow computer is a bottleneck in our work.
words.ex_cn: 这台慢电脑是我们工作的瓶颈。
words.en: A bottleneck is a point of congestion in a system that occurs when workloads arrive too quickly for the system to handle. In terms of traffic, it refers to a narrow section of road or a junction that impedes traffic flow.

words.ex: The book fell to the bottom of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书掉到了架子的底部。
words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: The bird sat on a heavy bough.
words.ex_cn: 鸟停在一根粗壮的树枝上。
words.en: A bough is a large branch of a tree.

words.ex: He walked down the wide boulevard with many shops.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着满是商店的宽阔大马路散步。
words.en: A boulevard is a wide street in a city, usually with trees along the sides.

words.ex: She bought a bouquet of flowers for her mom.
words.ex_cn: 她为妈妈买了一束花。
words.en: A bouquet is a bunch of flowers that is attractively arranged, especially one that is given to someone as a present.

words.tr:
n. 中产阶级的人；资产阶级的人
adj. 中产阶级的；追求名利的；资产阶级的
words.ex: He lives a bourgeois life with a big house and a car.
words.ex_cn: 他过着资产阶级的生活，有一栋大房子和一辆车。
words.en: If you describe people, their way of life, or their attitudes as bourgeois, you are criticizing them for caring too much about money and possessions and for being too conventional.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.ex: He has pain in his bowels.
words.ex_cn: 他肚子疼。
words.en: The bowels are the long tube in the body through which food passes while it is being digested after it has left the stomach.

words.ex: She wears a silver bracelet every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天戴一条银手链。
words.en: A bracelet is a piece of jewellery that you wear around your wrist or arm.

words.ex: He moved up to a higher bracket after his promotion.
words.ex_cn: 他升职后进入了更高的等级。
words.en: A bracket is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is fastened to a wall in order to support something such as a shelf. In writing, brackets are symbols that are used to separate words or numbers.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.ex: The tree has many branches.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树有许多分支。
words.en: A branch of a tree is one of its parts that grows out from its trunk. A branch of a business or organization is one of its offices or shops that are in different places.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.ex: He bought a brass lamp at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个黄铜制品台灯。
words.en: Brass is a yellow-coloured metal made from copper and zinc. It is used especially for making ornaments and musical instruments.

words.ex: The brave firefighter saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从火中救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is brave is willing to do things which are dangerous, and does not show fear in difficult or dangerous situations.

words.ex: The mother fed her baby with her breast.
words.ex_cn: 母亲用乳房喂养她的婴儿。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or the similar part on a bird or animal.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.tr:
v. 酿造；沏；酝酿
n. 酿造的饮料；啤酒
words.ex: He brews coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上冲咖啡。
words.en: If you brew tea or coffee, you make it by pouring hot water over tea leaves or ground coffee. If you brew beer, you make it by soaking grain in water and then fermenting it.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.

words.ex: He carries a briefcase to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带着公文包去上班。
words.en: A briefcase is a flat, rectangular container with a handle, used especially for carrying papers and documents.

words.ex: The fire brigade arrived quickly.
words.ex_cn: 消防队很快就到了。
words.en: A brigade is a large unit of an army, typically consisting of three or more battalions and forming part of a division.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.tr:
n. 刚毛；猪鬃
v. 大为恼怒；耸起毛发
words.ex: The brush has stiff bristles for cleaning pots.
words.ex_cn: 这把刷子有坚硬的刚毛，用来清洗锅具。
words.en: A bristle is a short, stiff hair, usually one of many on an animal or brush. As a verb, it can mean to react angrily or defensively, or (of hair or fur) to stand upright away from the skin, typically as a sign of anger or fear.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.ex: The statue is made of bronze.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由青铜制成。
words.en: Bronze is a yellowish-brown metal which is a mixture of copper and tin.

words.ex: She wore a silver brooch on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一枚银色胸针别在外套上。
words.en: A brooch is a piece of jewelry that has a pin at the back so it can be fastened to a dress, blouse, or coat.

words.tr:
n. 小河；溪
v. （不）忍受；（不）容忍
words.ex: The child jumps over the brook.
words.ex_cn: 孩子跳过小溪。
words.en: A small stream; to tolerate or allow something.

words.tr: n. 兄弟关系；手足情谊；兄弟会
words.ex: The two friends showed brotherhood during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 这两个朋友在困难时期展现了兄弟情谊。
words.en: Brotherhood refers to the relationship between brothers, or more generally, a feeling of friendship and support among people.

words.ex: They shared a brotherly bond that transcended their differences.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间有一种超越差异的兄弟情谊。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as brotherly, you mean that it is kind and affectionate, like the way a brother would behave.

words.tr:
n. 刷子；灌木丛；
v. 刷；
words.ex: He cleaned the floor with a brush.
words.ex_cn: 他用刷子打扫了地板。
words.en: A brush is an object with a handle and a large number of bristles, hairs, or wires fixed to it, used for cleaning, painting, or arranging hair.

words.ex: He gave a brute answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了粗暴的回答。
words.en: A brute is a person who is cruel and violent.

words.tr:
n. 雄鹿；公羊；雄兔；美元
v. （马等）猛然弓背跃起；抵制
words.ex: The buck ran through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 雄鹿在森林中奔跑。
words.en: A buck is a male deer, antelope, rabbit, or hare. It can also refer to a dollar in American slang. As a verb, it means to jump or to resist something.

words.ex: He meditates near the statue of Buddha.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在佛像附近冥想。
words.en: A Buddha is a person who has attained full enlightenment and has realized the ultimate truth.

words.ex: The buffalo walks slowly across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 水牛缓慢地走过草原。
words.en: A buffalo is a large animal of the cattle family, with long, curved horns. In North America, the buffalo is also called the bison.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.ex: A bug crawled on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只小虫子爬在叶子上。
words.en: A bug is a small insect, or it can refer to a fault in a computer program or system.

words.ex: He plays the bugle at morning parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在晨练时吹小号。
words.en: A bugle is a simple brass instrument consisting of a metal tube with a narrow opening at one end and a flared opening at the other end, played by blowing into it.

words.ex: The bulb broke when it fell on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 灯泡掉到地上时碎了。
words.en: A bulb is the glass part of an electric lamp, which gives out light when electricity passes through it. It can also refer to a rounded underground storage organ present in some plants, notably those of the lily family, consisting of a short stem surrounded by fleshy scale leaves or leaf bases, lying dormant over winter.

words.ex: The bulldozer cleared the path for the new road.
words.ex_cn: 推土机为新道路清理了路径。
words.en: A bulldozer is a large tractor with a blade in front, used for moving earth and rocks in construction work.

words.ex: The soldier picked up a bullet from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 士兵从地上捡起一颗子弹。
words.en: A bullet is a small piece of metal with a pointed or rounded end, which is fired from a gun.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.tr: adj. 似公牛的；看涨的；上扬的；乐观的
words.ex: The bull looks bullish as it charges forward.
words.ex_cn: 公牛向前冲时显得似公牛的。
words.en: If someone is bullish about something, they are confident that it will be successful or improve.

words.ex: He ate a bun for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个面包卷。
words.en: A bun is a small, usually round piece of bread. It can also refer to a hairstyle in which the hair is gathered into a tight coil or knot at the back of the head.

words.tr: n. 一束；一串；一群；大量
words.ex: A bunch of birds flew over the tree.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过树顶。
words.en: A bunch of things is a group of them. A bunch of people is a group of them who are together or who are connected in some way.

words.tr:
n. 捆；束；包
v. 匆匆送走
words.ex: He bought a bundle of newspapers.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一捆报纸。
